customer: I'm trying to sell my pickup to Northwind Auto and now I'm told my ex has to sign off because her name is still on the title. We're divorced, I just moved to Brevin, and the last thing I want is to track her down for a signature. Is there really no way around this?
agent: I understand the frustration, and there may be a way around it. If your ex is still listed on the title, she normally has to sign the same as any co-owner. However, if your divorce decree awards the truck to you, just bring a certified copy of the decree and her signature isn't needed. Also, if your name changed in the divorce, please see our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID."
